verdict.rationale: LiveKit Cloud documents reverting an agent deployment to a previous version and instant rollback, which implies versioned deployments for agents, the closest thing it has to automations. Nothing in the pack shows a review step such as diffs or approvals, and the rollback claims come only from pricing-page bullets. missing for 10: documented version history/listing of agent deployments, review or diff/approval workflow before deploy, in-depth docs on rollback mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
